effect.black-white: Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

flavor_text.black-white: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opponent’s team. The trap hurts opponents that switch into battle.
